name: Nashe Vyster
original_name: ナッシュ・ベイスター
source:
A wanderer mercenary. She travels around different towns working as a guard. A tough and strong woman wielding a sword as memento of her father. She still has no experience with men because she never dated one.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=2784]Getchu[/url].]
